skills.name: refactor-python
skills.description: Refactor Python code for readability and performance
skills.instructions:
# Refactor Python Code Skill

When asked to refactor Python code:
1. Analyze the current code for code smells
2. Apply appropriate refactoring patterns
3. Ensure tests still pass
4. Add type hints if missing

skills.name: write-unit-tests
skills.description: Write comprehensive unit tests for Python functions
skills.instructions:
# Write Unit Tests Skill

When writing unit tests:
1. Use pytest framework
2. Cover happy path and edge cases
3. Mock external dependencies
4. Aim for >80% coverage
